A school district may require 24 successful completion of an approved course of instruction for 25 school bus drivers. An approved course of instruction for 26 school bus drivers includes one or more of the following: 27 (1) A course of instruction for school bus drivers approved 28 by the department of education. 29 (2) Entry-level driver training completed in accordance 30 with section 321.188, subsection 1, paragraph “c” , if such 31 training meets the requirements of 49 C.F.R. pt. 380, Appendix 32 C, and 49 C.F.R. pt. 380, Appendix D. 33 (a) The department of education, in collaboration with 34 the department of transportation, shall adopt rules pursuant 35 -1- HF 395.1392 (4) 91 th/ns 1/ 3 #1. to chapter 17A on or before July 1, 2026, establishing 1 requirements for providers of entry-level driver training to 2 comply with this subparagraph. 3 (b) The rules must provide for minimum training content, 4 contact hours, and proficiency standards, and must establish a 5 standard training course duration that ensures each training 6 course provides all entry-level driver training requirements 7 and specified school bus driver training requirements, 8 including but not limited to training necessary for a passenger 9 endorsement and a school bus endorsement. 10 (3) Other training as described in a resolution adopted by 11 the school district, which may include but is not limited to 12 certain portions of a course described in subparagraph (1) or 13 (2). 14 b. If a school district requires successful completion of an 15 approved course of instruction for school bus drivers, a school 16 bus driver shall complete the course before or within the first 17 six months of employment and at least every twenty-four months 18 thereafter. 19 c.
